profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Titus Human Performance

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in requirements analysis and design
•	Involved in design and implementation of user interfaces, business layers, and data access layers.
•	Design and developed UI screens and forms using xaml (WPF)
•	Design database using Code First with Entity Framework 5
•	Implemented Core application framework components.
•	Implemented Authentication and authorization using custom web services to a central user database
•	Implemented User Interface Design and Development. 
•	Involved in writing SQL statements using Joins and Stored procedures for use in SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports  
•	Created custom c# validators for all form validations in the application
•	Created click once deployment package for auto updating

positions.title: Real Estate Investor
positions.description: Managed rental properties own by a small group. We currently own 12. They are now managed by a property management company.

positions.title: Senior Software Devloper
positions.description:
•	Participated in requirements analysis and design.
•	Developed application logic using asp.net
•	Designed a scalable CSS architecture and HTML Components.
•	Accessibility, globalization and localization.
•	Develop the UI using jQuery UI and Knockout 
•	Worked on Cascading Style Sheets.
•	Build system Scripts and web service calls.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was handpicked to participated in a start up venture to create a social media site that enabled people to store life experiences which could later be accessed after their death by family and friends. The application was completed but never went to market. Company folded  due to lack of continued funding.
